summary: קיר denotes a wall or masonry surface.
note:
Independent קיר noun entry. Psalm 62:4 supplies the in-scope occurrence.

Root (2026-11-21): Filed under the hollow root קיר: the noun keeps ī in every form and no Hebrew verb of the root is attested. Moabite qr 'town' is a lead only; Isa 22:5 מְקַרְקַר קִר plays on the word but does not show a root.
